blocking: Optional-field validation can strand submission when JavaScript or fetch is unavailable: an invalid field inside the closed planning-details section cannot reliably receive focus.

fixes.what: Render optional planning details open by default; close them only after installing the invalid-field expansion handler. Install that handler independently of fetch support.
fixes.why: Native submission must remain usable when an invalid optional number is hidden inside collapsed details.

fixes.what: Capture submitted values and preserve subsequent edits; reset only if the current form still matches the submitted snapshot, or temporarily lock its fields while submitting.
fixes.why: The current unconditional form.reset() erases edits made while the request is pending.

fixes.what: Add a clearly visible 2px gold outline with an offset instead of removing the outline and only brightening the existing underline.
fixes.why: The subtle underline and background changes make keyboard focus unnecessarily difficult to locate.

fixes.what: Pause repeating leaf tweens when their sections leave the viewport and resume them when visible; retain the existing reduced-motion cleanup.
fixes.why: Both infinite animations currently keep updating offscreen decorative elements throughout the visit.
